in_hebrew.name: ניל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Neill is derived from the Hebrew word 'nayil', which means 'grace, generosity'. This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible, but the concept of grace and generosity is prevalent throughout its pages.

in_greek.name: Νείλος
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Neill is derived from the Greek word 'Neilos', which means 'river, powerful one'. This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible, but the name of the Nile River is mentioned in various scriptures.

in_latin.name: Neillus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Neill is derived from the Latin word 'niellus', which means 'young man, warrior'. This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible, but it is a common Latin name.
